source_results.interpretation: v067 and v068 are preserved unchanged. Their scale dependence motivates testing whether the linear AeST solution approaches conventional nonlinear-power thresholds in the same k region and whether the eta=0 memory tangent shifts that onset.

scope: Linear-theory onset diagnostic only. This test does not simulate nonlinear dynamics, nonlinear saturation, halos, screening, or N-body evolution.

direct_spectrum_grid.evaluation: Direct classy.pk_lin at every requested (k,z). No native-grid P(k) interpolation is used.

dimensionless_power.definition: Delta_L^2(k,z) = k^3 P_L(k,z)/(2 pi^2), with k in 1/Mpc and P_L in Mpc^3
dimensionless_power.crossing_rule: For each threshold and redshift, take the first upward crossing as k increases from the low-k boundary. Locate it by linear interpolation of ln Delta_L^2 versus ln k between the two direct-evaluation grid points bracketing the threshold.

primary_response.definition: d ln k_thr / d eta = [ln k_thr(+lambda) - ln k_thr(-lambda)]/(2 lambda)
primary_response.interpretation_if_positive: Positive eta shifts the fixed Delta_L^2 threshold to larger k (smaller spatial scales), consistent with delaying the onset of nonlinear clustering in the linear diagnostic.
primary_response.interpretation_if_negative: Positive eta shifts the threshold to smaller k, consistent with advancing the onset in the linear diagnostic.

science_classification_after_numerical_p.delay: V069_MEMORY_DELAYS_LINEAR_NONLINEAR_ONSET if at least 80% of all threshold-redshift mean responses are positive and at least 5/7 Delta_L^2=1 responses are positive.
science_classification_after_numerical_p.advance: V069_MEMORY_ADVANCES_LINEAR_NONLINEAR_ONSET if at least 80% of all threshold-redshift mean responses are negative and at least 5/7 Delta_L^2=1 responses are negative.
science_classification_after_numerical_p.numerical_fail: V069_NONLINEAR_ONSET_DIAGNOSTIC_FAIL if any primary numerical gate fails.

secondary_descriptive_tests.threshold_ordering: Report whether the median absolute onset-scale response increases from Delta_L^2=0.1 to 0.3 to 1.0. This is descriptive and is not a PASS gate.
secondary_descriptive_tests.baseline_onset_scale: Report baseline k_thr(z) for all three thresholds.
secondary_descriptive_tests.transition_relation: Compare the onset scales with the previously observed qualitative increase of memory response toward k approximately 0.08--0.2 h/Mpc. No post-hoc redefinition of thresholds is allowed.

anti_tuning: Thresholds, k range, redshift grid, tangent amplitudes, crossing definition, numerical gates, and science-classification rule are committed before the v0.69 result. v0.67 and v0.68 remain historical FAILs under their original preregistered gates.
